chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Ibn Muskān, from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man died and left six brothers and a grandfather. He said: “He is like one of them.”

key_terms.جَدًّا: grandfather, the paternal ascendant considered in inheritance division
key_terms.سِتَّةَ إِخْوَةٍ: six brothers, the surviving siblings mentioned in the inheritance case
key_terms.كَأَحَدِهِمْ: like one of them, meaning counted as one among the brothers for the ruling

ai.seo_question: How is the grandfather counted in inheritance when a deceased man leaves brothers?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance involving brothers and a grandfather. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that the grandfather is treated like one of the brothers in this case, indicating his share is reckoned alongside them.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5643 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ibn Muskan from Abu Baṣir, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who died and left behind six brothers and a grandfather.
Imam (as) said: "The grandfather is considered as one of them."
